// Fixture: multi-pass Shadertoy project (tabs pasted into one file).
// ==== Common ====
const float TRAIL = 0.96;
vec2 orbit(float t) { return 0.5 + 0.3 * vec2(cos(t), sin(t * 1.3)); }

// ==== Buffer A ====
// ffmaker: iChannel0 = Buffer A
void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = fragCoord / iResolution.xy;
    vec4 prev = texture(iChannel0, uv) * TRAIL;
    float d = length((uv - orbit(iTime)) * vec2(iResolution.x / iResolution.y, 1.0));
    vec3 dot = vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.2) * smoothstep(0.05, 0.0, d);
    fragColor = vec4(max(prev.rgb, dot), 1.0);
}

// ==== Image ====
// ffmaker: iChannel0 = Buffer A
void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
    vec2 uv = fragCoord / iResolution.xy;
    fragColor = vec4(texture(iChannel0, uv).rgb, 1.0);
}
